periods.time: vol-15 ch-002, late funeral night before sunrise

name.zh: 一辉与史黛菈战前约定生还
name.en: Ikki and Stella vow to survive before the war

periods.location: Observation platform in Freyaveg central park
periods.summary: After the League border army's defeat, Stella admits she fears Ikki dying in a real war; Ikki answers that he chooses to fight for her homeland and promises he will return alive.
periods.cause: News of Naseem destroying the League assault force and killing Carlo makes Stella confront the possibility that Ikki could die in a war outside tournament rules.
periods.process: Stella prays for the League dead and tells Ikki that she no longer fears Naseem for herself because the Crimson Princess has her people's support. She then asks whether Ikki truly needs to participate, arguing he is only a student knight and Sirius's earlier condition is obsolete. Ikki lightly teases her, then explains that if Japan were endangered Stella would never run, and he likewise has many reasons to protect his lover's homeland and family. Stella breaks down and admits she is terrified of losing him. Ikki embraces her, apologizes for joking, and promises not to lose or die because Stella's side is where he belongs. Stella asks for more assurance, and they kiss.
periods.outcome: Stella chooses to trust Ikki as her strongest beloved rival, and both enter the representative war determined that neither will die.
periods.aftermath: The representatives spend the final night according to their own styles before dawn brings the war.
periods.significance: Converts Stella's fear for Ikki into mutual trust, enabling her later decision to leave Ikki's fall to him and focus on rescuing John.
